test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

My brother has sent me a message.

options.text: A message has been sent to me by my brother.
I have been sent a message to by my brother.
A message have been sent to me.
A message was sent to me by my brother.

solution:
The correct answer is **"A message has been sent to me by my brother."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ 

__
 
• The given sentence is in Present Perfect Tense and Active Voice.
 
• The rule for changing a Present Perfect Tense from Active voice to Passive voice:
 
• Interchange the object and subject with each other, i.e. object of the active sentence become the subject of the passive sentence.​
 
• Subject is "My brother" and object is "a message" in active voice.
 
• So, the subject is "a message" and object is "my brother" in passive voice.
 
• Structure__:
 __
 
• Subject + has/have + V3 + Object (Active Voice)__
 
• Object + has/have + been + V3 + by + Subject __(Passive Voice)__
 
 
 
• Example:
 
 
• *Disha has arranged the things. *(Active Voice)
 
• *The things have been arranged by Disha.** *(Passive Voice)
 
 
 
• Therefore, the​ correct answer is Option 1.

 

​​Correct sentence: *A message has been sent to me by my brother.*
